item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-02
item.description:
Our open-source research community has seen exciting progress across multiple projects. The `scienceverse/metacheck` project has added statistical output to its `data_check` branch, potentially building on the work of E.J. Lakens. Meanwhile, `marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing` has updated its `gh-pages` branch with a new site build and modified its `master` branch with changes to the success alert title. Notably, `lhdjung/scrutiny` has seen updates to its CITATION.cff file and deployed new content to its GitHub pages site twice, indicating a push for transparency and sharing of research outputs. Additionally, `quest-bih/oddpub` has enhanced its ontogenerator with the ability to detect "nature das and cas", further expanding its functionality. These developments demonstrate the connections and advancements being made across our community, and we look forward to seeing the continued growth and collaboration among our projects.

item.title: scrutiny: activity update
item.description:
lhdjung/scrutiny

The `main` branch saw changes to the CITATION.cff file, with Lukas Jung updating it, and later adding a `date-released` field. The `gh-pages` branch was deployed to twice, first from commit `a81cd540332cf402c1ffc798f93534c31da17009` and then from commit `0fd47d0e2ffee48a24c1806c4e4bcd2da5d4e238`, with the message "Deploying to gh-pages" accompanied by a rocket ship emoji. Both deployments were made by lhdjung, indicating a push of updated content to the GitHub pages site. The `main` and `gh-pages` branches were the focus of these recent changes.

⚠ This repository was dormant and has recently become active again.
